title: Conditional κ = .00389821126 (+0.00000590014235% over #8066; +0.00003232252752% over #8057): lower the native K7 opening floor
body:
## Verified result

**Conditional κ = 0.00389821126.** The exact increase over independently reproduced [#8066](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8066) at **0.00389821103** is **0.00000000023**, or **(2300/389821103)%**. The exact increase over [latest external #8057](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/cbe847a953b971f9c6c5a0a6661e2008acd29086/research/frequency-weighted-native-multiplier) at **0.00389821** is **0.00000000126**, or **(126/3898210)%**. The installed comparison cap is strictly below the new κ under the same five signed research premises.

The actual K7 opening floor is 18,960 across all five ordinary recipes. Its charged factor pays debit 1405/1024 with the complete 47/20 child allowance and 375/376 contraction. The old floor exceeds the new allowance, and the previous debit at the new heights falls short even with ideal booking. The paid profile (8192,129406,523443) and Gaussian H485263 lowers complete recurring log₂ C by 320 to 318292711. Conservative fixed native setup remains below 2^228.

## Reproduce

Use Git and CPython 3.12 at `04228ea5a1292cf8526a20037060f6fc6e15a858`.

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-weighted-ordinary-floor
```

All seven modes passed in 243.82 seconds, with actual floor callbacks, all 2,907 bins of the reduced occupied K7 test, 323,165 opens and closes, 432 paid prefixes, no remaining locks, and 683,705,746,532 charged axes. Both signed finite tape tests, the exact exterior and nested owner returns, and signed product −345550037539 passed. The independent verifier separately rebuilt the paid axis ledger and passed the old-floor and old-debit negatives. Repository metadata, committed source and modes, onboarding (760 tests with 31 skips), and historical replay passed. All hosted checks passed on this exact head, including the complete [seven-mode scientific replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/45083185079/job/137396845046).
